flow flow.batch v1
title: Batch run
start: each
stage run: Run
step each [Repetition] Each item
  stage: Run
  does: Goes through `items` one item at a time, up to 5 items; the current item is in `current`.
  body: For each round: go to Run the child
  onExhausted: If the rounds run out: go to Broken
  next: When every item has been handled: go to Wait until the visit
step child [Child process] Run the child
  stage: Run
  does: Starts the process `flow.child` and waits until it ends. It sends `current`.
  next: When the process ends: go to Each item
  onError: If the process fails: go to Broken
step nap [Timer] Wait until the visit
  stage: Run
  does: Waits until 1 hour after `visit_at`.
  next: When the time comes: go to Ask for a pick
step ask [AI answer] Ask for a pick
  stage: Run
  does: Asks an AI model (`model-a`, prompt `pick` version 2) through `assist.pick`. It sends `batch_ref`. It keeps `pick` and `count`. The rule `conf.flag_rule` judges the answer next.
  next: When an answer fits: go to Verify the pick
  onError: If it fails: go to Broken
  onNotAvailable: If the connection is not available: go to Broken
  onInvalid: If the answer does not fit the expected form: go to Broken
  ai input: batch_ref
  ai input schema: {"properties":{"batch":{"type":"string"}},"required":["batch"],"type":"object"}
  ai output schema: {"additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"pick":{"type":"string"},"size":{"type":"integer"}},"required":["pick"],"type":"object"}
  ai fills: pick, count
  ai judged by: conf.flag_rule
  ai note: The model and the prompt are fixed in the document: `model-a`, prompt `pick` version 2.
  ai note: It gets 1 attempt to give an answer that fits the expected form.
  ai note: The rule `conf.flag_rule` judges the answer next.
  ai note: When the answer never fits, the call fails or the AI is not available, the flow does not stop: it goes on at Broken.
step check [Repeated read] Check the pick
  stage: Run
  does: Reads `records.state` again and again until `flag` is `true`. It reads every 1 minute, for at most 45 minutes. It sends `batch_ref` and `state_count`. It keeps `state_count`. If the call fails for a passing reason it tries again, up to 2 attempts in all.
  next: When the answer says it is done: go to Judge the count
  onError: If it fails: go to Broken
  onNotAvailable: If the connection is not available: go to Broken
  onNotEntitled: If the plan does not include it: go to Broken
  onExpired: If the time runs out: go to Broken
step judge [Decision] Judge the count
  stage: Run
  does: Judges with the rule `conf.default_rule` using `count`. The result field `level` says where the flow goes.
  on:high: If `level` is high: go to Finished
  on:low: If `level` is low: go to Broken
  onNoDecision: If the rule gives no result: go to Finished
  onError: If the rule cannot be applied: go to Broken
step ok [End] Finished
  stage: Run
  does: Ends the case with the result Finished.
step broken [End] Broken
  stage: Run
  does: Ends the case with the result Broken.
step verify [Decision] Verify the pick
  stage: Run
  does: Judges with the rule `conf.flag_rule` using `count`. The result field `flag` says where the flow goes.
  on:false: If `flag` is false: go to Broken
  on:true: If `flag` is true: go to Check the pick
  onNoDecision: If the rule gives no result: go to Broken
  onError: If the rule cannot be applied: go to Broken
